peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 18.9% above its local comparables; 44 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (77.5): 5.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 39 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2015.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

bands.positionText: near the peer median (its range includes it)

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,080,000 ($2,230 psf, 484 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,850 psf (range $1,421–1,982); 20.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $184,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,580,000 ($2,353 psf, 645–678 sq ft; 11 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,004 psf (range $1,849–2,405); 17.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $234,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,470,000 ($2,267 psf, 1,076–1,162 sq ft; 8 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,910 psf (range $1,870–2,090); 18.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $389,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Mar 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 6 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Paya Lebar MRT about 50 m, Dakota MRT about 980 m; closer than 50 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 830 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 12 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 150 m), more than 51 of 51 similar developments; nearest hawker centre Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre about 330 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,740 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Haig Road Market And Cooked Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 760 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 980 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,080 m; Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 1,140 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,300 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,350 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,370 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,440 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 419 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 371 new sales and 901 resales (1,272 purchases); new sales were 29.2% of these purchases. Subsales (70) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 901 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 44 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 901 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,039 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.3%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
